sam_sales: Urgent for demo in 20m — Prospect tried a single POST with ~25 MB of concatenated reports and got 413. They want a one-step fix.

rita_se: 413 = gateway limit. Do they embed PDFs as base64 in JSON? That will balloon size.

sam_sales: Yep. They sent base64 blobs inside the payload.

ben_oncall: Fastest options (ranked): 1) gzip payload client-side + Content-Encoding: gzip. 2) presign upload -> ingest pattern. 3) chunk and run retrieval/embeddings.

hana_support: Gzip is the quickest patch. Example one-liner I can DM:
```
echo -n "$(cat docs.txt)" | gzip -c | curl -X POST \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ 
  -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' \ 
  --data-binary @- 'https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate?model=rwd-4x'
```
Note: compression reduces transport but tokens billed after decompression.

sam_sales: They also reported getting 429s after retrying. Why would that happen?

ben_oncall: If they retry immediately after a 413, bursts can trigger rate limiting at the edge. Advice: do not auto-retry on 413. If 429 happens, use exponential backoff and respect Retry-After.

hana_support: If you need guaranteed success, we can temporarily whitelist their demo IP and raise client_max_body_size to 50MB for 60 minutes. That requires SOC approval. I'll open a ticket if you want.

sam_sales: Yes please open ticket — demo in 18m. Also send presign cURL in case gzip doesn't fit their workflow.

hana_support: Presign flow (minimal):
1) POST /presign -> returns upload_url + key
2) PUT upload_url with file
3) POST /ingest {"key":"<s3_key>","model":"rwd-4x"} -> we fetch and run generate
Minimal cURL chain I'll DM.

ben_oncall: Also remind them to avoid base64-in-JSON. If they must send binary, presign is safer.

audit_bot: ticket-12045 created: demo-body-limit-exception for IP 198.51.100.99. Request: raise proxy body limit to 50MB for 60m. Pending SOC approval.

sam_sales: Thanks all. Sending gzip example + presign option to the prospect now. Will follow up after the call with session id so eng can pull logs. :thumbsup:
